entities.summary: Junior Jones is an American former professional boxer who competed from 1989 to 2002. He held world championships in two weight classes, including the World Boxing Association (WBA) bantamweight title from 1993 to 1994 and the World Boxing Organization (WBO) super bantamweight title from 1996 to 1997. He also held the International Boxing Organization (IBO) featherweight title from 1999 to 2000, which is a minor world title. Junior Jones was a athletes & competitors from Brooklyn (b. 1970-12-20, Brooklyn). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
